## 🔍 Validation & Testing

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes:

### 1. Automated Test Results
- [ ] All `Jest` integration tests pass (`cd backend && npm test`)
- [ ] No compilation/build warnings in Next.js (`cd frontend && npm run build`)

### 2. Manual Verification
- [ ] Verified local database connection via Docker Compose (`docker compose up -d`)
- [ ] Checked search/filter query parameters
- [ ] Tested JWT security boundary conditions on POST, PATCH, and DELETE operations

## 📋 Types of Changes
*Please check the options that are relevant:*

- [ ] **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] **New Feature** (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] **Breaking Change** (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] **Refactoring** (code organization, no functional changes)
- [ ] **Documentation Update** (changes to README, guides, etc.)
